mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_commission_detail (user_id, openid, from_user_id, order_no, pay_amount, commission_amount, transfer_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{openid}, #{fromUserId}, #{orderNo}, #{payAmount}, #{commissionAmount}, #{transferTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, openid, from_user_id, order_no, pay_amount, commission_amount, create_time, transfer_time FROM t_commission_detail WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission_amount), 0) FROM t_commission_detail WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transfer_time IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission_amount), 0) FROM t_commission_detail WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transfer_time IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_commission_detail WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
